h1: College Haus Rangnam — Kitchen, Washer & Saltwater Pool — 5-Minute Walk to Rajavithi Hospital
intro: If you need to stay several nights near Rajavithi Hospital and want to cook your own meals rather than eating out every day, College Haus Rangnam is unlike most hotels in this area. Every unit comes with a kitchenette, fridge, and washing machine — genuine apartment-style living for long-term stays. The hotel is tucked into a quiet alley off Rang Nam Road, just 400 m and roughly 5 minutes on foot from Rajavithi Hospital, with Phyathai 1 around 500 m away. Add a saltwater pool, 24-hour gym, and free parking, all from approximately ฿1,100 per night — with a guest score of 8.9 from 311 verified Booking.com reviews.

body.html: College Haus Rangnam was not built for weekend visitors. With 151 apartment-style units each fitted with a kitchenette, fridge, and private washing machine, the property is purpose-built for extended stays. Its most loyal guests are family members of patients at Rajavithi Hospital, Phyathai 1, or the Queen Sirikit National Institute of Child Health (Children's Hospital) — people who need a comfortable base for a week or more, where they can cook a simple meal, run a load of laundry, and rest without hotel-restaurant bills stacking up.

The location sits in Chawakul Alley off Rang Nam Road — quieter than the main Ratchawithi Road corridor, yet just steps from it. Rajavithi Hospital is roughly 400 m away, about a 5-minute flat walk along the pavement, no need to wait for a motorcycle taxi every morning. Phyathai 1 Hospital is around 500–650 m. BTS Victory Monument station is approximately 450 m, making it equally easy to travel onward into Bangkok or catch a minibus back to any province from the Victory Monument roundabout.

"The room with a kitchen and washing machine was very convenient for a long stay — I could cook for myself and save a lot on food. The saltwater pool was a great way to unwind after a hard day at the hospital."

Room categories range from Standard Queen through to Deluxe Pool View and Suite. Every category includes air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, kitchenette, fridge, and washing machine. The Deluxe Pool View rooms look directly over the saltwater pool and garden, and guest reviews consistently call these the best value upgrade for only a modest price difference. Standard rooms facing the alley are perfectly comfortable, just without the view. Room sizes are practical rather than generous — sized for a long-term resident rather than a resort-style retreat.

Shared facilities punch above the hotel's price point. The outdoor saltwater pool gets consistently positive mentions — guests say it is larger than expected and well-maintained, open throughout the day. The fitness center runs 24 hours and is accessed with a room key card. Free private parking is available for guests who drive — a genuine rarity in this part of Ratchathewi, and invaluable for provincial visitors arriving by car. An on-site massage clinic offers guests a 10% discount. There is no main restaurant; a small coffee kiosk operates mornings to mid-afternoon, and local food shops and 7-Eleven branches line Rang Nam Road within a few minutes' walk.

Guest reviews across Booking.com and Trip.com skew positive, with particular praise for value, cleanliness, and the peaceful atmosphere despite the central location. Common complaints focus on Wi-Fi reliability — some rooms experience intermittent signal — along with weak shower pressure in certain units and occasional musty smell in older rooms. These are recurring issues worth knowing before you check in: ask for a recently renovated room, report Wi-Fi problems to the front desk immediately, and confirm which floor you prefer if shower pressure matters.

For families of patients who anticipate staying a week or more near Rajavithi Hospital, College Haus Rangnam makes a strong practical case. The combined saving on food costs alone — cooking rather than eating three restaurant meals a day — can easily offset the slightly higher nightly rate versus a basic guesthouse. Factor in free laundry, free parking, and a pool to decompress in, and the value proposition for a long-term visitor is clear. From approximately ฿1,100 per night, it is priced modestly for what it offers.

honestSummary: College Haus Rangnam is best suited to family members of patients who need to stay for several nights or weeks near Rajavithi or Phyathai 1 hospitals. The apartment format with kitchenette, fridge, and in-room washer makes it significantly more economical than standard hotels for long visits. The saltwater pool and gym provide real relief after long hospital days. If you need rock-solid Wi-Fi for remote work or a larger, more comfortable room, compare with nearby options first — but for the core use case here, it delivers.
honestChecks: If you need fast, stable Wi-Fi for video calls or remote work — several reviews flag intermittent connectivity in certain rooms. Ask to be placed near a Wi-Fi access point and report any issues to reception right away before assuming the problem is building-wide

If you are only staying 1–2 nights and will not cook or do laundry — the apartment amenities go unused and the slightly higher rate versus a basic hotel is harder to justify. SHIN Hotel or Hi Sotel nearby offer comparable hospital proximity at lower nightly rates

If breakfast in the hotel is important to you — College Haus has no main restaurant, only a small morning coffee kiosk. Food options on Rang Nam Road are plentiful and affordable, but you will need to step outside or self-cater

tips.title: Upgrade to a Pool View Room
tips.body: The Deluxe Pool View rooms cost only a little more and look directly over the saltwater pool and garden — a much more relaxing backdrop after long hospital days, well worth the small price difference

tips.title: Report Wi-Fi Issues Immediately
tips.body: If your room has a weak signal, tell reception straight away rather than living with it — staff can usually fix it or move you to a better-connected room. Mention it at booking if Wi-Fi is essential

tips.title: Stock Up at the Rang Nam 7-Eleven
tips.body: Convenience stores and a local fresh market are a short walk along Rang Nam Road. Stocking the in-room fridge with basics means you can cook simple meals and significantly cut daily food costs during a long stay

tips.title: Use Victory Monument as Your Travel Hub
tips.body: BTS Victory Monument is about 450 m away, and the roundabout runs minibuses to every Thai province. Getting around Bangkok or travelling home to the provinces is straightforward from here

faq.q: How far is College Haus Rangnam from Rajavithi Hospital?
faq.a: College Haus Rangnam sits in Chawakul Alley off Rang Nam Road, approximately 400 m from Rajavithi Hospital — about a 5-minute flat walk along the pavement, with no need for a taxi or motorcycle. Phyathai 1 Hospital is around 500–650 m, and the Queen Sirikit National Institute of Child Health (Children's Hospital) is about 800 m away.

faq.q: What are the room rates at College Haus Rangnam?
faq.a: Rates start from approximately ฿1,100 per night for a Standard Queen Room. Deluxe Pool View rooms begin around ฿1,400, and Suites from around ฿2,000. If you are planning a stay of several weeks, contact the hotel directly about weekly or monthly rates, which may offer a better deal.

faq.q: Does every room really have a kitchen and washing machine?
faq.a: Yes — every unit includes a kitchenette, fridge, and in-room washing machine, consistent with the property's apartment-hotel concept. This is designed for guests staying long-term rather than overnight tourists.

faq.q: Is College Haus Rangnam suitable for families staying near a hospital?
faq.a: It is very well-suited. The 5-minute walk to Rajavithi Hospital, in-room cooking and laundry facilities, free parking for those who drive, and a pool to unwind in after exhausting hospital days make it one of the most practical long-stay options in this neighbourhood. Total costs including meals are typically lower than staying at a regular hotel.

faq.q: How far is BTS Victory Monument from the hotel?
faq.a: BTS Victory Monument station is approximately 450 m away, around a 5–6 minute walk. From there you can reach any BTS station in Bangkok, and the Victory Monument roundabout nearby has minibus routes to every Thai province.

faq.q: Is there free parking at College Haus Rangnam?
faq.a: Yes, free private parking is available for guests. This is a significant advantage for visitors who drive from upcountry — parking charges at nearby hotels can add hundreds of baht per day.
